findings.title: Mandatory Minimum Requirements
findings.fact: To qualify for the proposed opportunity, the organizations intending to participate must meet the following requirements: An organization at the federal tax identification (FTID) number level, independent of number of sites, is eligible to submit a single request for up to $10,000. Organization must be 501(c)(3) non-profit. Organizations will be able to access the full amount of awarded funds once disbursement requirements are met. Awarded funds will be disbursed, via pass through agent, OhioPro. All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025. Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure it is a 501(c)(3) non-profit and can comply with the expenditure deadline and reporting requirements.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify 501(c)(3) status and plan for full expenditure by September 29, 2025, and reporting by November 7, 2025.

quotes.quote: To qualify for the proposed opportunity, the organizations intending to participate must meet the following requirements: • An organization at the federal tax identification (FTID) number level, independent of number of sites, is eligible to submit a single request for up to $10,000. • Organization must be 501(c)(3) non-profit. • Organizations will be able to access the full amount of awarded funds once disbursement requirements are met. Awarded funds will be disbursed, via pass through agent, OhioPro. • All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025. • Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey. OhioMHAS will provide the survey link and the SOS questionnaire (if applicable) for required reporting. Completed surveys are due no later than November 7, 2025. The survey link will be provided upon awarding of funds.
